objective: Construct and prove: the 1-collared tiles of all pinwheel patches (a tile with every tile touching it, written in the tile's own affine frame, with handedness) form a finite set closed under Conway's cut, computed from one triangle; for a fixed number j of cuts, every complete collar's j-fold cut contains the radius-2 neighbourhood of every dart whose tail lies in its central tile's descendants; so the radius-2 atlas of every pinwheel tiling (the oriented labels of PINWHEEL-NATIVE-20261107-001B with the unlabelled rooted radius-2 codes) is computed exactly from the complete collars. Show that each oriented label is a function of its code in this atlas. Consequence: PINWHEEL-NATIVE B's radius-2 reading holds on every pinwheel tiling, and the atlas is a finite local law for tickets B and C.
status: Proved (PINWHEEL-ATLAS-20261107-001A-P001): the complete radius-2 atlas of the pinwheel law. The collared tiles of all pinwheel patches form 193 keys closed under the cut (108 complete, in 54 mirror pairs); four cuts of each complete collar contain the radius-2 neighbourhood of every dart in its centre, so every pinwheel tiling's radius-2 darts take exactly 1,168 forms, each with one oriented label: in every pinwheel tiling each edge's label is a function of the unlabelled planar map within radius 2 (radius 1: 198 forms, 9 with two labels). The atlas equals the level-7 patch's interior codes.
title: The complete radius-2 atlas of the pinwheel law
